after_snippet:
import numpy as np

# In 2.0.0+, use vstack instead of row_stack
a = np.array([1, 2, 3])
b = np.array([4, 5, 6])
result = np.vstack([a, b])
assert result.shape == (2, 3)
before_snippet:
import numpy as np

# In 1.26.4, row_stack was available
a = np.array([1, 2, 3])
b = np.array([4, 5, 6])
result = np.row_stack([a, b])
assert result.shape == (2, 3)
title: numpy.row_stack has been removed
